description: This file defines the PublisherRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository for managing Publisher entities. It includes methods to find a publisher by ID and to retrieve all publishers, both using entity graphs to fetch associated books.

classes.name: PublisherRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Publisher entities, extending JpaRepository with custom entity graph queries.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a Publisher by its ID, including associated books via entity graph.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Publisher entities, including their associated books via entity graph.
